title: 第90章 都挺嚣张，暴力破局

第90章 都挺嚣张，暴力破局-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

不愧是重案组组长，脑子转得就是快，顾承安点了点头，没多解释。

苏楠也没多问，她转身打开电脑上的警务通，在文件验证功能里输入了传唤令的编码，系统比对显示文件真实有效。

她才点击打印，“嗞嗞”两声，打了两份出来。

“给。”她把纸递过来，“还有别的需求吗？”

“帮我保密。”顾承安接过传唤令，折好放进兜里。

“知道了。”苏楠拿起桌上的对讲机按了一下，“关欣、马路，到我办公室来一趟。”

不到一分钟，两个人推门进来。

走在前面的是那个熟悉的大块头，今天上午还见过。

缘分啊。

后面跟着个精瘦的年轻人，寸头，眼神机灵。

苏楠一一介绍了下，原来大块头叫关欣，另一个是马路。

顾承安在心里默念了一遍这两个名字，忍住了吐槽的冲动，一个关心一个马路，这重案组的人名是有什么讲究吗？

“这位是公安部的顾警官，”苏楠简短交代，“接下来你俩配合他行动，听他指挥。”

“是！”两人齐声应道。

“走吧。”顾承安冲苏楠点了下头，带着两人出了办公室。

没开警车，也没开重案组那辆标志性的面包车，三个人直接上了顾承安的212。

关欣坐副驾，马路上了后座，系好安全带。

顾承安发动车子，同时拿出手机快速查了一下吴灿锋的定位——还在那个饭店。

粤庭会门口，212停进车位。

三个人下车，顾承安走在前面，推开饭店大门。

还是那个美女服务生在迎宾，她看见顾承安打头的三人，对这个中午吃花胶鸡的帅哥印象颇深，这会儿只不过换了身衣服。

“欢迎光临，请问三位是用餐吗？”她迎上来，

“我们是市局的，来找个人。”顾承安开口道。

美女服务生迟疑了一下。

顾承安偏了下头。

马路很有眼色地上前一步，掏出工作证，在她面前亮了一下，然后也没放回兜里，直接挂在脖子上，一旁的关欣也跟着把证件挂了出来。

服务生的表情从迟疑变成了配合。

As expected of the leader of the serious crime team, his mind works very quickly. Gu Chengan nodded without explaining much.

Su Nan didn't ask any further questions. She turned around and opened the police app on her computer, and entered the subpoena code into the document verification function. The system comparison showed that the document was authentic and valid.

She just clicked on print, "嗗嗗"" twice, and typed out two copies.

"Here." She handed the paper over, "Anything else you need?"

"Keep it secret for me." Gu Chengan took the summons, folded it and put it in his pocket.

"I know." Su Nan picked up the intercom on the table and pressed it, "Guan Xin, Malu, come to my office."

In less than a minute, two people pushed the door open and came in.

Walking in front was the familiar big man whom I had seen this morning.

What a fate.

Behind him was a lean young man with short hair and sharp eyes.

Su Nan introduced them one by one. It turned out that the big guy was called Guan Xin and the other one was Ma Lu.

Gu Chengan recited these two names silently in his mind and resisted the urge to complain. One cares about the other. Is there anything special about the names of the serious crime team?

"This is Officer Gu from the Ministry of Public Security," Su Nan explained briefly, "You two will cooperate with his actions and follow his instructions."

"Yes!" they both responded in unison.

"Let's go." Gu Chengan nodded to Su Nan and led the two of them out of the office.

Without driving a police car or the iconic van of the crime team, the three of them got directly into Gu Chengan's 212.

Guan Xin took the passenger seat, got into the back seat on the road, and fastened her seat belt.

Gu Chengan started the car and took out his mobile phone to quickly check Wu Canfeng's location - he was still in that hotel.

At the entrance of Yuetinghui, park in the parking space 212.

The three of them got out of the car, and Gu Chengan walked in front and opened the hotel door.

The beautiful waiter was still greeting the guests. When she saw the three people headed by Gu Chengan, she was deeply impressed by this handsome guy who had fish maw chicken for lunch. He just changed his clothes now.

"Welcome, are you three having a meal?" She came up to greet her.

"We are from the city bureau, looking for someone." Gu Chengan said.

The beautiful waiter hesitated.

Gu Chengan tilted his head.

Ma Lu took a step forward with discernment, took out his work ID card, flashed it in front of her, and then hung it around his neck without putting it back in his pocket. Guan Xin, who was beside him, also hung up his ID card.

The waiter's expression changed from hesitant to cooperative.
